name: when-free
description: Which days and times am I free? Reads your calendars and answers with the slots you can offer. Read-only.
long_description: Ask Claude when you are free, or paste the message asking for your availability, and it answers from your real calendar: Google, Outlook, iCloud or any .ics feed. It understands explicit dates and words like "next week" or "any afternoon", keeps a buffer around events, and never sees event titles unless you ask. It only reads: it cannot create, change or delete anything. Runs on your computer; no account, no API key.

tools.name: free_slots
tools.description: Free time per day for the days asked about, from explicit dates, a range, or a message.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Whether you are free right now, until when, and your next free slot. No event titles.

tools.name: check_calendars
tools.description: Whether each calendar can be read, with event counts. No details, no addresses.

calendars.title: Calendar addresses
calendars.description: The private iCal address of each calendar, separated by commas. Google: Settings, your calendar, Integrate calendar, "Secret address in iCal format". Leave empty to use the calendars you saved with `whenfree add`.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: Like Europe/London. Leave empty to use your computer's.
